files.validation: No exported profile format or import/export route identified in build 40; shared secure-preferences code does not certify .sks support.

catalog.format: WakkoDev/MD5/AES-256-CBC; URL-Base64 nonce12/ChaCha20-Poly1305/tag16 around URL-Base64 IV16/AES-256-CBC fields; native version-derived 16 ASCII chars padded to 32 bytes; Java ROT19
catalog.remoteAuthorization: User explicitly authorized both external server and user catalogs
catalog.validation: Whole embedded and live documents match independent JDK oracle. Native ARM64 KDF/SHA checked for four versions. Live dual CLI, isolated worker and authenticated broker through real private HTTP worker match both full oracle documents.
catalog.cloudSource: Both fixed direct Dropbox server and user sources. Full documents and independent versions under catalogs.servers/catalogs.users; any source failure rejects the combined request.
catalog.liveTransportScope: Real Python HTTPS downloads, original signed redirects and direct sources byte-identical. Native Node DNS returns EAI_AGAIN here; broker DNS/IP/TLS checks use controlled tests and authenticated HTTP-worker parity uses captured authorized source bytes. No live VPS deployment claimed.

icon.policy: Exact default launcher WebP retained; PNG converted losslessly with identical RGBA pixels, no resizing or substitute artwork.
